messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Disconnected from the server
parts:
I think the issue is that you can't use anything that uses Tcl or Tk since they require access to the DISPLAY, and there is no DISPLAY that is available to you since the application is running on the server.  With shiny applications, the display is the browser.  
Hope this helps.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Disconnected from the server
parts:
If the app is coming up and shutting down after some time, you may be running out of memory, so you can increase the instance size.  
It was hard to tell from the original note whether the app was crashing immediately.
Sorry about that.
-Tareef

On Tue, Apr 5, 2016 at 1:19 PM, cc <chu...@gmail.com> wrote:
again i don't think that's the issue. 
i just made a change of my attached datafiles, cutting then in half, and the app seems to hold and working, and the same "no DISPLAY variable so Tk is not available" msg still appears in the log.
the problem is that the smaller datasize does impact the app's performance. maybe i have to live with it .
it bothers me that i can't see the actual error msg that shuts down the server connection...

On Tue, Apr 5, 2016 at 12:04 PM, Tareef Kawaf <tar...@rstudio.com> wrote:
I think the issue is that you can't use anything that uses Tcl or Tk since they require access to the DISPLAY, and there is no DISPLAY that is available to you since the application is running on the server.  With shiny applications, the display is the browser.  
Hope this helps.

On Tue, Apr 5, 2016 at 12:59 PM, cc <chu...@gmail.com> wrote:
app does not use any tcltk pkg, only standard text boxes. 
i noticed the msg on Tk, and actually included tcltk2 library but still the same.
i am wondering if the attached datafile size (which will create a large vector) caused the problem, but log does not indicate that?

On Tue, Apr 5, 2016 at 11:46 AM, Tareef Kawaf <tar...@rstudio.com> wrote:
Without hte URL it is hard to know exactly, but it looks like you are using a package that requires access to the DISPLAY and shinyapps.io (and shiny server) can't support any packages that rely on Tcl/Tk.
